questions.q: Which work area does a requester like Dana use to submit a request for goods or services?
options: Invoices
Receiving
Self Service Procurement (Purchase Requisitions)
Purchase Agreements
questions.explain: Requesters submit requisitions through the Self Service Procurement work area, sometimes labeled Purchase Requisitions.

questions.q: What is the best way to describe the difference between a module and a work area?
options: They are exactly the same thing with different names
A module is a type of purchase order
A work area is only used for reporting, never for transactions
A module is how Oracle organizes functionality and security behind the scenes; a work area is the landing page scoped to a specific role's tasks
questions.explain: Modules organize functionality and security; work areas are the task-scoped landing pages built on top of them for each role.

questions.q: Marcus (the buyer) tells Dana her requisition is not lost. What is the most likely explanation?
options: It is most likely sitting in an approval queue belonging to someone else
Requisitions are deleted automatically after 24 hours
Oracle Fusion has no way to track requisitions after submission
Dana must have submitted it to the wrong company entirely
questions.explain: A requisition that appears to disappear is very often waiting in an approver's queue rather than actually lost.

questions.q: What does a segregation of duties (SoD) policy typically prevent?
options: A supplier from submitting more than one invoice per month
The same person from performing two conflicting duties, such as creating and approving the same purchase order
A requester from ever viewing their own requisition history
Receiving clerks from logging into the system on weekends
questions.explain: SoD policies are designed to prevent one person from controlling both sides of a sensitive transaction, like creating and approving the same document.

questions.q: Which role is responsible for confirming that the pump bearings physically arrived at LTV Manufacturing's dock?
options: Priya, the receiving clerk
Dana, the requester
Chen, the AP processor
A segregation of duties policy
questions.explain: Receiving personnel, Priya in this course's transaction, confirm physical receipt of goods in the Receiving work area.
